evidence.reason: Line 102 still invokes gitleaks with only `--config`; it does not remove or replace the scanned checkout's `.gitleaksignore`. In gitleaks v8.30.1 the ignore file is loaded from the working tree independently of the rules TOML, so a PR can add a secret plus its fingerprint to `.gitleaksignore` and suppress the finding without touching the trusted config. The denylist check is a required blocking check under current contract item 17, so this is an implementation defect, not a hardening proposal.
